title: Can Bash Save the Day?
statementMd:
Whoa! You did a great job helping Team Rocket who managed to capture all the Pokemons sent by Bash. Meowth, part of Team Rocket, having already mastered the human language, now wants to become a master in programming as well. He agrees to free the Pokemons if Bash can answer his questions.

Initially, Meowth gives Bash a weighted tree containing $*n*$ nodes and a sequence $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}..., *a*_{*n*}$ which is a permutation of $1, 2, ..., *n*$. Now, Mewoth makes $*q*$ queries of one of the following forms:

- `1 l r v`: meaning Bash should report ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/816a5c5f7673f6efda3e7eb855b33f1cd0660d88.png), where $*dist*(*a*, *b*)$ is the length of the shortest path from node $*a*$ to node $*b*$ in the given tree.
- `2 x`: meaning Bash should swap $*a*_{*x*}$ and $*a*_{*x* + 1}$ in the given sequence. This new sequence is used for later queries.

Help Bash to answer the questions!

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*q*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 2·10^{5}$, $1 ≤ *q* ≤ 2·10^{5}$) — the number of nodes in the tree and the number of queries, respectively.

The next line contains $*n*$ space-separated integers — the sequence $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ which is a permutation of $1, 2, ..., *n*$.

Each of the next $*n* - 1$ lines contain three space-separated integers $*u*$, $*v*$, and $*w*$ denoting that there exists an undirected edge between node $*u*$ and node $*v*$ of weight $*w*$, ($1 ≤ *u*, *v* ≤ *n*$, $*u* ≠ *v*$, $1 ≤ *w* ≤ 10^{6}$). It is guaranteed that the given graph is a tree.

Each query consists of two lines. First line contains single integer $*t*$, indicating the type of the query. Next line contains the description of the query:

- **t = 1**: Second line contains three integers $*a*$, $*b*$ and $*c*$ ($1 ≤ *a*, *b*, *c* < 2^{30}$) using which $*l*$, $*r*$ and $*v*$ can be generated using the formula given below:
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/41e63c8dc8bc8ccdd6518f3545d4ed6563ad0149.png),
  - ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d507471ec4ac41dfdb7ae85e8e229454a071fabf.png),
  - ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ef5c7174e223cf6451bba39d4eec35ac6d923636.png).
- **t = 2**: Second line contains single integer $*a*$ ($1 ≤ *a* < 2^{30}$) using which $*x*$ can be generated using the formula given below:
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d48156478483a72dae043d51512212446bbff09e.png).

The $*ans*_{*i*}$ is the answer for the $*i*$-th query, assume that $*ans*_{0} = 0$. If the $*i*$-th query is of type 2 then $*ans*_{*i*}$ = $*ans*_{*i* - 1}$. It is guaranteed that:

- **for each query of type 1**: $1 ≤ *l* ≤ *r* ≤ *n*$, $1 ≤ *v* ≤ *n*$,
- **for each query of type 2**: $1 ≤ *x* ≤ *n* - 1$.

The ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c4b7092c0f7ce6535f2574569c98f7b3c2fe2c5f.png) operation means bitwise exclusive OR.

## Output

For each query of type $1$, output a single integer in a separate line, denoting the answer to the query.

## Note

In the sample, the actual queries are the following:

- `1 1 5 4`
- `1 1 3 3`
- `2 3`
- `2 2`
- `1 1 3 3`
statementZhMd:
哇！你出色地帮助了火箭队，他们成功捕获了 Bash 派出的所有宝可梦。火箭队成员喵喵已经掌握了人类语言，现在还想成为编程大师。如果 Bash 能回答他的问题，他就同意释放这些宝可梦。

最初，喵喵给 Bash 一棵包含 $*n*$ 个节点的带权树，以及一个序列 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}..., *a*_{*n*}$，该序列是 $1, 2, ..., *n*$ 的一个排列。现在，喵喵会进行 $*q*$ 次以下形式之一的询问：

- `1 l r v`：要求 Bash 报告 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/816a5c5f7673f6efda3e7eb855b33f1cd0660d88.png)，其中 $*dist*(*a*, *b*)$ 表示给定树中节点 $*a*$ 和节点 $*b*$ 之间最短路径的长度。
- `2 x`：交换给定序列中的 $*a*_{*x*}$ 和 $*a*_{*x* + 1}$。这个新序列将用于之后的询问。

请帮助 Bash 回答这些问题！

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*q*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 2·10^{5}$，$1 ≤ *q* ≤ 2·10^{5}$）——树中节点的数量和询问的数量。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个以空格分隔的整数——序列 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$，该序列是 $1, 2, ..., *n*$ 的一个排列。

接下来的 $*n* - 1$ 行中，每行包含三个以空格分隔的整数 $*u*$、$*v*$ 和 $*w*$，表示节点 $*u*$ 和节点 $*v*$ 之间存在一条权重为 $*w*$ 的无向边（$1 ≤ *u*, *v* ≤ *n*$，$*u* ≠ *v*$，$1 ≤ *w* ≤ 10^{6}$）。保证给定的图是一棵树。

每次询问包含两行。第一行包含一个整数 $*t*$，表示询问的类型。第二行包含询问的描述：

- **t = 1**：第二行包含三个整数 $*a*$、$*b*$ 和 $*c*$（$1 ≤ *a*, *b*, *c* < 2^{30}$），使用下方给出的公式生成 $*l*$、$*r*$ 和 $*v*$：
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/41e63c8dc8bc8ccdd6518f3545d4ed6563ad0149.png)，
  - ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d507471ec4ac41dfdb7ae85e8e229454a071fabf.png)，
  - ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ef5c7174e223cf6451bba39d4eec35ac6d923636.png)。
- **t = 2**：第二行包含一个整数 $*a*$（$1 ≤ *a* < 2^{30}$），使用下方给出的公式生成 $*x*$：
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d48156478483a72dae043d51512212446bbff09e.png)。

$*ans*_{*i*}$ 表示第 $*i*$ 次询问的答案，设 $*ans*_{0} = 0$。如果第 $*i*$ 次询问的类型为 2，则 $*ans*_{*i*}$ = $*ans*_{*i* - 1}$。保证：

- **对于每次类型 1 的询问**：$1 ≤ *l* ≤ *r* ≤ *n*$，$1 ≤ *v* ≤ *n*$；
- **对于每次类型 2 的询问**：$1 ≤ *x* ≤ *n* - 1$。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c4b7092c0f7ce6535f2574569c98f7b3c2fe2c5f.png) 运算表示按位异或。

## 输出格式

对于每次类型 1 的询问，输出一个整数，表示该询问的答案。每个答案单独占一行。

## 说明

在样例中，实际的询问如下：

- `1 1 5 4`
- `1 1 3 3`
- `2 3`
- `2 2`
- `1 1 3 3`
